spec_match.rationale: Six real scenarios mapping the boundary of the change: timer win, client abort, network win, fast control, redirect-loop genuine failure, passthrough abort.

interactive.rationale: Real controls invoke the exact API surface and render live results; no static code card.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index card describes exactly what this page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Negative/fallback branches are exercised and reported verbatim, including unexpected outcomes.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5124748525830144 and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite covers this page's contract but the race-specific assertions are manual (worker + server race cannot run from the /conformance/ route).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright/headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: Chrome 153: both cancellation rows 'Failed to fetch', network-win/fast resolved, redirect loop 'Failed to fetch' (served to the page as a 200 sw-error-page so no console error), passthrough abort produced no worker report in 5 s (recorded as observed). Only deliberate client-abort ERR_ABORTED request failures.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the primary contract branch and the fallback/legacy branch.

design_system.rationale: Design-system CSS variables only; buttons override background and color together; AA contrast.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with visible labels, focus-visible outlines, live-region verdicts, focusable scroll regions for tables.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes: 0px horizontal overflow, ≥44px targets, tables scroll within a region.

openQuestions.title: Explain the passthrough-abort non-report
openQuestions.detail: When the page aborts a request answered by respondWith(fetch(event.request)), the worker's promise never reported in 5 s on Chrome 153. Investigate whether the fetch event is torn down and whether 159 changes this.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for asynchronous status results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results through polite live regions and keep native controls with visible labels and focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are aria-live polite; all controls are native button/input/select with visible labels; :focus-visible outline on every control.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: At least 44x44 targets on touch, components adapt to container width, no page-level horizontal scroll.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: min-height 44px on buttons/inputs/range sliders; wide tables scroll inside a focusable region; measured 0px document overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: progress indicator for long running task
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose progress with a native progress element and announce completion.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: <progress> with aria-label and text fallback; final verdict in a live region.

summary: Six real scenarios mapping the boundary of the change: timer win, client abort, network win, fast control, redirect-loop genuine failure, passthrough abort.
